propositions: plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing/unverifiable when they are created by a ticket the plan depends_on, even though the prose rubric says such symbols should be treated as existing
the grounding logic honors only the origin/main snapshot and never considers prerequisite tickets' planned file impacts, causing false-positive blocks on valid depends_on-created symbols

a machine-parseable citation grammar [rebar:<ticket-id>] must be introduced and honored bidirectionally: both when the plan declares depends_on(cited-id) and when the cited ticket declares blocks(plan)
Layer-1 (deterministic advisory) must parse citations, verify edges against both P.depends_on and reverse-lookup of C.blocks, and treat reverse-lookup failures fail-closed without blocking

Layer-2 (LLM agent) must judge whether a cited ticket's file_impact covers the specific functionality claimed missing, and credit the citation only if both the edge is verified and coverage is affirmatively confirmed
uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations must never suppress a missing-symbol finding — the grounding finding stands when Layer-1 or Layer-2 conditions are not met
